summary: IperionX Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting the commissioning of a 300-ton six-axis SACMI powder metallurgy press at its Titanium Manufacturing Campus in South Boston, Virginia. The press triples existing powder metallurgy capacity, capable of up to 24 pressing cycles per minute (≈11 million single-cavity parts per year), expanding production of titanium components like fasteners, gears, brackets, and actuators for defense, aerospace, and industrial use. It uses titanium powder from IperionX's HAMR process and integrates with HSPT sintering and forging furnaces. The filing is an operational update—no special situation transaction (acquisition, divestiture, etc.) is involved. What to watch: expansion of U.S. titanium component manufacturing capacity.
